id.description: The id canoa.cfg records as `provider`: a word of lower-case letters, digits and `_`, 1 to 32.

help.description: A line saying what it reads.

types.description: The Store types it serves, by id (`overlays`, `skills`, `mcps`, `extensions`, or a type an extension added); none means every type.

schema.description: The values its form asks for, as a guatiao schema of an object; none for a source that asks for nothing. A member the schema marks sensitive is never shown in clear.

form.description: How the schema is shown, a guatiao-intake form document; none shows the form the schema implies.

kind.description: The id of the Store type the catalog is of.

label.description: The label the person gave the catalog.

fields.description: What the form's fields hold, as a JSON object of what the schema's members hold, keyed by member name. A field the person left empty is absent, so the provider uses its own default.
